_readme: ATS capability matrix — machine-readable registry of tested ATS boards/platforms. Populated from EVIDENCE ONLY (code paths, HTTP probes, tests, and docs listed per entry). Boards with no evidence carry status 'unverified' with no guessed flags. This registry records CAPABILITY FLAGS only (what is reachable/verifiable, what walls exist) — it carries no submission mechanics, request fingerprints, bypass techniques, or payload details. Evidence paths are relative to the repo root.

applytojob.notes: Application form is server-rendered with a known multipart POST action, but Google reCAPTCHA v2 is wired into submit (pure HTTP cannot mint a token).
applytojob.verification_method: HTTP probe 2026-09-14 (monetizem sample: 200, full server-rendered form, 39 inputs, known POST action) + supervised re-verification 2026-09-16 confirming reCAPTCHA v2 wired into submit; edge_probe http_render_check protocol

ashby.notes: jobs.ashbyhq.com posting pages are a JS app shell not renderable over plain HTTP fetch. Board listings available via the public posting API (api.ashbyhq.com/posting-api/job-board/<board>).
ashby.rate_limit_notes: Ashby flags repeated automated submit attempts as possible spam (employer_form_patterns.json platform_priors 'ashby': flagged sessions complete the form but cannot submit; retries recover only ~1/3)
ashby.verification_method: HTTP probe 2026-09-15 (Hims & Hers, Thumbtack pages not HTTP-renderable); browser submission proven live (Sierra via browser path); edge_probe http_render_check protocol; prescreen blind-ATS priors

bamboohr.notes: Detection pattern exists in ats.py but no probe evidence is on file.

breezy.notes: No captcha/auth wall observed on sampled pages (no recaptcha/hcaptcha/turnstile/enterprise markers, no API key, no login gate). The pre-flight is dry-run question-mapping validation only — live HTTP submit is not wired; transport verdict browser_only.
breezy.rate_limit_notes: 13 HTTP reqs across 9 boards during the 2026-09-15 alt-ATS trial, zero 429s
breezy.verification_method: read-only HTTP probe 2026-09-15 (ARM 100): server-rendered AngularJS apply page with a real form + honeypot, platform REST client defining POST /apply/<positionId>; breezy_preflight.py dry-run validation; edge_probe http_render_check protocol

careerpuck.notes: Third-party career-board host, often proxying Greenhouse embeds (e.g. Udemy, Lyft, Domino). Resolve the proxied ATS per posting. is_aggregator=true.
careerpuck.verification_method: live HTTP probe 2026-09-15 (Vite React app shell, 0 <form>; CSP frame-ancestors explicitly allow greenhouse.io / lever.co / ashbyhq.com / applytojob.com / pinpointhq.com — embeds underlying ATS boards); edge_probe http_render_check protocol

comeet.verification_method: HTTP probe 2026-09-15 (JS-rendered apply form embedded on employer domains via comeet-applyform script); edge_probe http_render_check protocol

eightfold.notes: Registry entry exists (edge_case_registry.json) but the verdict is 'unknown' with no probe evidence on file — carries no capabilities.

greenhouse.notes: RETIRED 2026-09-18 (Keel Blocker Resolution Directive §1, Workstream A): API-direct is retired as a write transport (lifecycle RETIRED_WRITE_PATH). api_direct_supported now reports False by policy via ats_matrix.capability() and engines/api_direct_policy.py. Prior True claims are historical evidence only — not a live write capability. Discovery/inspection remain ALLOW (api_direct_detect.py, lever_submit.py, board-API enumerate modules). Prior note: api_direct_supported is qualified: legacy non-Enterprise boards only. Modern job-boards.greenhouse.io boards render reCAPTCHA Enterprise (pure HTTP cannot mint an enterprise token) and stay on the browser path. The form-blob gate refuses listing mirrors / SPA shells (e.g. securly13).
greenhouse.rate_limit_notes: 0 HTTP 429 observed across edge probes and the 2026-09-15 async verify run (60 leads, 2.7 min). api_direct_detect fail-closes on fetch failure.

greenhouse_legacy_embed.evidence_note: RETIRED 2026-09-18 (Keel Blocker Resolution Directive §1, Workstream A): API-direct is retired as a write transport (lifecycle RETIRED_WRITE_PATH). api_direct_supported now reports False by policy via ats_matrix.capability() and engines/api_direct_policy.py. Prior True claims are historical evidence only — not a live write capability. Discovery/inspection remain ALLOW (api_direct_detect.py, lever_submit.py, board-API enumerate modules). Prior evidence note: edge_case_registry.json 'greenhouse_legacy_embed' verdict viable_direct (14/14 detection tests); older boards.greenhouse.io embeds may lack the Enterprise endpoint

greenhouse_modern.evidence_note: edge_case_registry.json 'greenhouse_modern' verdict browser_only: GitLab, Anthropic, xAI, Neo4j, AIO Logic boards all refused by api_direct_detect (Enterprise marker present)

greenhouse.verification_method: production traffic (api_direct_detect dry-run gates inside apply_loop verify/launch; form-blob gate) + edge_probe greenhouse_detect protocol + HTTP probes of sample URLs

greenhouse_embed.notes: form_probe_ok covers question extraction only; submission candidacy is evaluated on the board URL form via api_direct_detect.
greenhouse_embed.rate_limit_notes: no direct-submission path wired for the embed URL form; the api-direct fast lane uses the board URL form (boards|job-boards.greenhouse.io/<board>/jobs/<id>)
greenhouse_embed.verification_method: form_intel.greenhouse_embed_intel extracts the server-rendered question structure over plain HTTP (form_intel.py probe_url)

lever.verification_method: endpoint probes + frontend inspection 2026-09-15 (403 wall, hCaptcha sitekey e33f87f8... on two unrelated orgs); form_intel hCaptcha carrier injection 2026-09-16; edge_probe lever_wall_check protocol

tealhq.verification_method: live-lead evidence (Filigran lead: TealHQ apply route unresolved until browser STEP 0) + edge_probe aggregator_check protocol

teamtailor.verification_method: HTTP probe 2026-09-15 (board and postings render over HTTP, job text readable; application form is a JS overlay); edge_probe http_render_check protocol

flags_documented.api_direct_supported: a clean pure-HTTP submission path is wired and tested for this board (no browser run needed)
flags_documented.form_probe_ok: form_intel (or an equivalent HTTP probe module) can extract the server-rendered application form / custom questions over plain HTTP
flags_documented.guest_discovery: public listing/posting pages are reachable over plain HTTP with no login (metadata, job text, board listings)

indeed.notes: No automated Indeed discovery. This adapter only resolves hand-provided Indeed URLs (operator-provided) to canonical ATS URLs via resolve_indeed_url(). Clearing the challenge would be bot-detection bypass — out of scope.
indeed.verification_method: live HTTP probe 2026-09-16 (plain urllib, standard browser UA, no login): /jobs, /viewjob, /rss all return HTTP 401/403 with a Cloudflare bot-detection challenge requiring JS clearance + login redirect

linkedin.notes: LinkedIn Easy Apply postings keep the LinkedIn page as the apply target but apply itself is browser-only. Offsite postings hide the employer apply URL from guests; the browser lane resolves the real apply route at runtime (Step 0).
linkedin.rate_limit_notes: HTTP 429 is a hard stop (exit 75, nothing written); 2s polite delay between requests, sequential, bounded pages
linkedin.verification_method: live HTTP probe 2026-09-16 (plain urllib, standard browser UA, no login): guest search returns ~10 server-rendered cards/page; job detail returns title/company/location/description + apply-route markers; fake id -> 404 (endpoint is real)
